sentences.en: These attempts to overturn the ordinance still need to pass through Congress.
sentences.zh: 这些试图推翻条例的努力仍然需要通过国会。

sentences.en: The city council passed an ordinance banning smoking in public parks.
sentences.zh: 市议会通过了一项法令，禁止在公共公园吸烟。

sentences.en: This new ordinance will help reduce noise pollution in our neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这项新条例将有助于减少我们社区的噪音污染。
